parsed.rationale: One of the two participating records lives at 'Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift' inside a path that contains 'Examples/WallpaperSampleApp', which is a canonical sample-app location. Per the decision rules, any cluster where at least one record is a sample-app file must be treated as intentional duplication. The 'MetricRow' type-alias in the Wallpaper package is almost certainly a local copy maintained for demonstration purposes, not a production duplicate that should be unified with the DebugPanel copy. Lifting the DebugPanel definition into a shared target and making the sample app depend on it would couple a demonstration artifact to production infrastructure, which is the exact anti-pattern the restraint rule guards against.
